title: Diwali On Hudson - Family Diwali Cruise Party
description: Get ready to dance and celebrate Diwali Bollywood style on a cruise with family and friends!
long_description:
Get ready to dance and celebrate Diwali Bollywood style on a cruise with family and friends!

About this Event

Celebrate the Festival of Lights on the water! Join Bollywood Nights NYC for a premium, family-friendly Diwali Cruise Party filled with music, dancing, festive energy, and unforgettable views of the New York City skyline.
Bring your family and friends, dress in your finest Indian or festive attire, and enjoy a beautiful evening celebrating Diwali together. From Bollywood beats and colorful lights to picture-perfect moments on the cruise, this experience is designed for both adults and children.
✨ Event Highlights
Family-friendly Diwali celebrationBollywood music and dancingPhotoboothBelly Dancer Performer Climate Control 3 Floor, 1 Open Deck Punjabi Dholi Spectacular NYC skyline viewsPremium cruise atmosphereFestive décor and photo opportunitiesFun evening for adults and childrenTraditional Indian or festive attire encouraged📅 Date: Saturday, November 7
⏰ Time: 6:00 PM–10:00 PM
📍 Boarding Location: Liberty Landing Marina
80 Audrey Zapp Drive, Jersey City, NJ 07305
Please arrive early to allow enough time for parking, check-in, and boarding. The cruise must depart on schedule, and late entry cannot be guaranteed.
For more information and table reservations, call Kish at (848) 247-8082.
Come aboard with your loved ones and celebrate Diwali under the stars—where festive traditions meet the magic of the NYC skyline! 🪔✨
